question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**brought**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The blank refers to a past action in the context of forest fires.
 
• The verb should align with the past tense to match the narrative of the passage.
 
• "**Brought**" fits well as it correctly conveys the past tense action.
 
• Other options ("**bring**", "**brings**", "**bringing**") do not fit the sentence structure or tense.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__ ** 

 
• **Bring:** "Bring" is present tense and does not fit the past narrative.
 
• **Brings: **"Brings" is present tense and does not match the past context.
 
• **Bringing:** "Bringing" is a present participle and does not fit the sentence structure.
